messages:
Priya: Quick feedback request on catalog compare layout — seeing visual jump when badges render after metrics load. Should we reserve badge space to prevent layout shift?

Sam: yes reserve. layout shift hurts perceived perf. use skeleton badge with fixed width so columns don't move.

Eleni: also the filter chips expand when showing counts and push compare columns. prefer truncation with tooltip for counts (hover/focus) so width is stable.

Raj: pin UX: current label reads 'Pinned' but it's unclear who pinned it. suggest 'Pinned (you)' vs 'Pinned (team)'. If session-only, show '(you)'. If workspace saved, show '(workspace)'.

Priya: agree. accessibility: badges need text alternatives, keyboard-focusable tooltips, and contrast >= 4.5:1. also add aria-live for badge updates to announce metric load.

Sam: small dev note: skeleton badges should match final width; we can use CSS var --badge-width and set fixed inline style to avoid CLS.

Eleni: copy nit for the pin action: use verb phrase 'Pin version' for action and status 'Pinned  v2.4.0' ? maybe 'Pinned  v2.4.0 (you)'. keep it short.

Raj: behaviour question: when a user pins in compare view should that persist if they navigate to model details and back? product thinks yes within session. dev to decide storage.

Priya: next steps: Sam to prototype skeleton badges + fixed widths, Eleni to update copy and tooltips in mock, Raj to draft session vs workspace pin storage options. design-bot: mock uploaded https://figma.com/file/mock-reserved-badges. Review Fri 9am.
